newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metro Pacific falls on property sector fears.
newsitem.headline: Metro Pacific falls on property sector fears.

text.p: Metro Pacific Corp slid by 40 centavos, or 5.26 percent, to seven pesos in late trade on Thursday on lingering concerns over a glut in the property sector, brokers said.
"It's still this skepticism on property issues," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities Inc.

Conglomerate Metro Pacific, local flagship unit of First Pacific Co Ltd, is part of the consortium which won the right to develop a 214-hectare site in Fort Bonifacio located at the edge of the financial district of Makati.
Henry Ong, analyst at Sapphire Securities said that negative sentiment about the property sector weighed down Metro Pacific.
But Jose Ricardo Garcia, executive vice-president at Diversified Securities said the drop should be seen as an opportunity to buy.
Metro Pacific was one of the top 10 most heavily traded issue during the session.
